name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details without hallucinating textures, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality more than generic upscalers. The trade-off is a slight speed hit—depth-aware upscaling adds 10-15% compute time—but the clarity gain outweighs it for high-stakes renders.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a spatial sharpening tool, not temporal. The real risk is wasting 10-15% compute on a dead end while VFI-Flow’s 20% throughput drop actually breaks the real-time pipeline. Test both: run depth-aware upscaling on a 10-second clip with motion blur, then swap in VFI-Flow—if the latter delivers sharper frames without frame drops, it’s the better lever.
